en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a large European square with cobblestone pavement. On the left stands an ornate neoclassical building with arched entrances, heavy stonework and sculptural decoration, resembling a theater or court. In the center and right background are several multi‑story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. A prominent commercial sign on the corner house reads "Möbel‑Magazin". People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the square and a few carriages or early automobiles are visible.
